notes.title: Delay in Game Release
notes.notes:
Dear gamers,

We regret to inform you that the release date for our game has been pushed back due to an unfortunate setback we encountered during the final stages of development. We lost an important file for the game and as a result, none of the animations are working properly, which are a crucial aspect of the gameplay experience.

We understand that many of you were eagerly awaiting the release of our game, and we apologize for any disappointment this delay may cause. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer all of our players a 5% discount on the launch date of the game.

Rest assured, we are working diligently to resolve the issue and ensure that the final product is of the highest quality.

We appreciate your patience and understanding as we work to get the game back on track. Thank you for your continued support.
